newsitem.title: USA: Robber in Dole mask urges victim to vote.
newsitem.headline: Robber in Dole mask urges victim to vote.

text.p: A man wearing a Bob Dole mask robbed a bank on Thursday, advising the teller "Don't forget to vote" as he fled with the cash.
The FBI said the incident occurred at the First National Bank in Wheaton, a Chicago suburb.
The man, who was wearing a business suit and pointing a gun, fled in a car with an undetermined amount of cash.
"He stopped, looked at the teller and said 'Don't forget to vote'," FBI spokesman Bob Long said.
Republican Dole, a former U.S. Senate majority leader, is challenging incumbent Democrat Bill Clinton for the U.S. presidency in Nov. 5 elections.
